messages.subject: Re: difference between rainfall simulation results in swat and swatplus model
parts:
Dear all,
I have set up both the SWAT and SWATPlus models for the water balance analysis. During this, I observed that the SWAT check yields different precipitation results than the SWAT model, even though the inputs are the same. What could be the possible reason for this?

Please help me in this regard. Looking forward to hearing from you all.
